content: Codex CLI: 'codex exec <prompt>' runs headless, streams progress to stderr, final message to stdout; --json emits JSONL events; --output-schema + -o forces structured final JSON; --full-auto or --sandbox danger-full-access control write/network permission. Gemini CLI: -p/--prompt triggers headless (also auto when non-TTY), --output-format json returns response+stats+metadata, --yolo auto-approves tool executions. All three major agentic CLIs converge on: prompt flag, NDJSON/JSON event stream, permission/sandbox flag, structured-output schema flag — which is the natural shape of a CLI-backed adapter interface.
